comment: EPO03 PROD-WORLD-LANDMARKS pending regions (DIR-03). x,y = crop origin on the 1024^2 atlas; w,h = crop size (generation and mask are exactly this size). `rect` is the authored rect in CROP coords (half-open) and equals the inpaint rect; ramps are one-sided from the rect edge rising inward, width-jittered +/-60%. Salts 120-139 are this team's. L3 first (outside the core, no golden); L2 after PROD-WORLD-SOUTH's region covering y 816-992 lands (re-extracts south_strand_w again); L1 last, after PROD-WORLD-WEST's core-face region lands (coreAuthor, D0033 s2).

regions.name: ice_bastion
regions.intent: The Ice-Mage Tower rebuilt on a glacial foundation: a crevassed bastion of three stepped terraces with blue south faces and drifts banked north, a crystalline tower footed at atlas (468,177), a 4-5 px frozen causeway with ice pillars winding up from the south-west, sastrugi around; nothing lit under the Frozen Shelf marker (445,176); frostmere_north_wall (y>=256) untouched.

regions.name: storm_pocket
regions.intent: The Storm House: a pocket of NE-SW darkness at least 25 L* below the surrounding heath fading out at the edge, a black-gabled house 28-34 px at atlas (218,900) with three amber windows, blasted trees leaning away from it (one split and charred), a wet track; the pocket is painted into the terrain, not a prop on it.

regions.name: fairy_glade
regions.intent: The Fairy Castle: a glade opened in the oak canopy, a castle grown from three living birch trunks with moss roofs and amber windows at atlas (335,452), a root bridge over a moss-green pool ringed with gold flower-lights, faint paths, a ragged copse edge; clear of the Greenwatch (286,431) and Whispering Woods (383,509) markers.
